title: Zacchaeus Meets Jesus
summary: Zacchaeus Meets Jesus is a short lesson with one main thread: Jesus seeks and saves lost people, and His grace changes lives. When someone has a bad reputation, Zacchaeus shows that Jesus can bring repentance that changes real behavior.

read_it.prompt: Read Luke 19:1-10. Notice one detail that would help a kid explain Zacchaeus Meets Jesus to someone else.

tell_it: Zacchaeus climbed a tree to see Jesus. Jesus came to his house, and Zacchaeus chose to make wrong things right. Kids can retell it by naming what happened, who responded, and what God showed.
understand_it: Kids can understand Zacchaeus Meets Jesus by asking what was at stake, what God revealed, and what response was faithful. Jesus seeks and saves lost people, and His grace changes lives.
age_5_7_explanation: Jesus noticed Zacchaeus and changed his home.
age_8_11_explanation: Jesus seeks and saves lost people, and His grace changes lives. The lesson helps older kids compare the story's wise path with the easier path people may have wanted.
teen_explanation: When someone has a bad reputation, Zacchaeus shows that Jesus can bring repentance that changes real behavior. Jesus seeks and saves lost people, and His grace changes lives. The story leaves room to talk about courage, humility, repentance, or hope without pretending the hard part is small.
key_truths: Jesus seeks and saves lost people, and His grace changes lives.
Zacchaeus Meets Jesus shows grace through a real Bible moment, not a slogan.
When someone has a bad reputation, Zacchaeus shows that Jesus can bring repentance that changes real behavior.
life_application: When someone has a bad reputation, Zacchaeus shows that Jesus can bring repentance that changes real behavior.

quiz_questions.question: Why did Zacchaeus climb a tree?
choices: Zacchaeus kept all the stolen money
Zacchaeus was too tall to see
quiz_questions.explanation: This answer keeps the focus where the Bible puts it: To see Jesus. Jesus seeks and saves lost people, and His grace changes lives.

quiz_questions.question: Name the pressure, problem, or need in Zacchaeus Meets Jesus.
quiz_questions.answer: Answers should name the story's real challenge and connect it to God's response.
quiz_questions.explanation: Good retelling notices what was hard before jumping straight to the takeaway.

memory_verse.prompt: Memorize or repeat Luke 19:10 as the Bible handle for this lesson.

discussion_questions: What surprised you in Zacchaeus Meets Jesus?
Why does grace matter in Zacchaeus Meets Jesus?
What would change if someone actually lived out the grace lesson in Zacchaeus Meets Jesus?

activity.title: Tree and Table Scene
activity.instructions: Draw Zacchaeus in a tree and a table below, then add what changed after Jesus came.

prayer_prompt: Jesus, help me remember the truth in Zacchaeus Meets Jesus and live it with people around me.
